mapper.sql: i.*, s.name AS store_name, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, ch.name AS channel_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name

FROM ecom_inbound i JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = i.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = i.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = i.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_logistics_channel ch ON ch.id = i.channel_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.create_by
